session: Fresh persisted Pi JSON session per attempt, four native tools, no extensions, automatic compaction defaults.
sampling: Production provider parameters, fixed seed per session, medium reasoning, 8192 thinking budget and 16384 maximum output per call. Wire bridge only adds a trial-unique cache salt.
ordering: Long task first, then ten selected issues, fresh-seed comparison on three cases, then matched routing/streaming fixtures. Only one model and one Pi at once.
primary: Frozen case, solution passes official regression and preservation tests. Agent completion and wall time reported independently.
feedback: Patch evaluation occurs after all primary solutions for each case are frozen. Pi never sees the reference solution or hidden tests.
corpus: Same initial text for both tokenizers. Pi may summarize the original source as part of normal session compaction.

long_compaction_treatment.scope: Same Django repair, adaptive DSpark and identical source for both retention settings.
